data.title: Bitdeer Hits Zero Bitcoin Holdings - Sold Every Coin It Mined While Raising $300M In Debt
data.summary: Bitdeer Technologies Group has liquidated its entire Bitcoin (BTC) holdings, selling all 189.8 BTC mined during the week and its remaining 943.1 BTC reserve, completing an eight-week drawdown. This zero-holdings disclosure followed Bitdeer's announcement of a $300 million convertible note offering and direct equity sale, aimed at funding its pivot towards proprietary ASIC chip development and AI data center infrastructure.
